in_sanskrit.name: Saidul
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Helper, Benefactor
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Saidul एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Saidul means Helper or Benefactor. It is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Seva Daan', which means 'service to others'. This name is often given to a child who is expected to grow up to be a kind and helpful person.
